lines.text: Many learners say: She is teacher.
An! My brother is an engineer.

native.tip: قبل المهنة نضع a أو an: “She is a teacher.” وليس “She is teacher.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “She is teacher.” 😅 قبل المهنة نضع a أو an، فالجملة الصحيحة “She is a teacher.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “an”. قبل المهنة نضع a أو an. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: Before a job we put a or an: “She is a teacher.” not “She is teacher.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “She is teacher.” 😅 Before a job we put a or an, so the right sentence is “She is a teacher.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
